chosen_because: GT-E2 synthesis section 7 (one-way release recommended) and GT-P006; coverage audit gravity-time/docs/e3-coverage-and-question-selection.md

clocks.continuous: pi_ct = pi_jump / R; release flux, one-way flux, expected recovery time (sum of mean holding times 1/R)
clocks.jump: events of the stationary jump chain: event order, partner frame, recovery events, recovery within H, gate distance (admissible steps)

comparisons.R1_ladder: path_form factor 1/2 (W4 weak), 1/4 (W4 strong), 1/9 (W3 strong), 1/16 (W16 strong), 0 (prohibit), FREE N=4 and 5: partner index and its split, one-way flux, recovery of witnessed releases (gate distance, expected recovery events and time, recovery within H, direct-recovery share) against unwitnessed releases. The soft rungs and the hard zero are qualitatively different (positive versus zero support); no limit is claimed
comparisons.R2_hard_against_dissolution: path_form prohibit with path_dissolve weak_suppress (W4), strong_suppress (W4) and strong_suppress (W16): soft sigma -log 2, -log 4, -log 16; sign and split of the partner index
comparisons.R3_soft_controls: path_form and path_dissolve strong_suppress (W16): rate-symmetric, sigma 0; path_form weak_suppress + path_dissolve strong_suppress (W4): soft sigma = -log 2 with no hard component
comparisons.R4_reversible_hard_and_null: EXCL (strict enabling, reversible) and NULL: recovery of path-witnessed versus unwitnessed releases with no rule acting on path witnesses (structural baseline)
comparisons.R5_scaffold: HELD N=5 path_form strong_suppress (W4, W16) and prohibit: the held triangle as a soft and as a hard witness
comparisons.R6_q12_scan: partner index of path_form(m_f) + path_dissolve(m_d) at FREE N=4 and N=5 on the 9x9 grid m = 2^k, k in {-3,-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2,3} (synthetic factors; a bounded counterexample search for GT-Q12, not a model of hard limits)

controls_and_identities.I1_I2: square identity on intact squares, zero on disjoint squares, with each cell's alphabet
controls_and_identities.S1_hard_path_form_support: every FREE cell with path_form prohibit: the reachable class is irreducible; a release is one-way exactly when the released relation is path-witnessed; every one-way release has gate distance >= 2 and every two-way release gate distance 1 (theorem T1-T4)
controls_and_identities.S2_soft_support: every cell without a hard component: no one-way transition and gate distance 1 for every release
controls_and_identities.S3_rate_symmetric: PFD strong_suppress+strong_suppress (W16) and NULL: uniform law (class L1 <= 1e-9) and flux <= 1e-9
controls_and_identities.S4_reversible_hard: EXCL: flux <= 1e-9 and no one-way transition
controls_and_identities.S5_scan_diagonal: scan points with m_f = m_d: flux <= 1e-9 and |partner index| <= 1e-12
controls_and_identities.Z5_numerical: gte2a checks (GTH, residual, symmetry, kernel and affinity references from rule strings, partner-frame loop, passage enumeration) plus: gate distance and one-way classification from the rule strings by forward BFS on 25 seeded releases per cell; expected recovery events by fixed-point iteration against the linear solve (|difference| <= 1e-8) on up to four slots
controls_and_identities.separation_note: S1-S5 are theorems or identities; none predicts the sign or size of any partner index, recovery time, direct-recovery share or scan outcome

deliberate_omissions.entropy_production: with one-way transitions the logarithmic entropy production diverges; gte0a excludes one-sided pairs from its sum, so reported values are of the two-sided part only and are flagged
deliberate_omissions.n6_n7: not needed: T1-T4 hold at every N, and N=4/5 show nontrivial one-way release; no FREE N=7
deliberate_omissions.new_alphabets: only W4, W3, W16 (existing); scan factors are a declared mathematical search

estimands: every gte2a channel plus release census, recovery (gate distance, expected recovery events/time, recovery within H, direct-recovery share), partner split and one-way flux; scans: sign agreement of partner index with sigma
initial_conditions: FREE starts at the empty graph and HELD at the source triangle; the reachable class from the start is analysed (gte2a policy: restriction to a unique closed class, otherwise structure only)
open_questions_without_prediction: Along the formation ladder 1/2, 1/4, 1/9, 1/16, 0, how do the partner index, its one-way part, and the recovery of witnessed releases change, and is the hard zero continuous with the soft rungs or qualitatively separate?
Can any available opposing dissolution term (soft sigma down to -log 16) reverse the orientation of hard path-form exclusion?
How long does a released, witnessed relation stay absent, by which route is it recovered, and how does that compare with unwitnessed releases and with the same structural event under soft rules?
How much of the partner index comes from event pairs that include a one-way transition?
What does the held triangle do as a soft witness (strong suppression) compared with a hard one?
Does any grid point of the scan have a partner index whose sign disagrees with sigma (GT-Q12)?

pre_freeze_exposure.derivations: T1-T4 derived before freezing; the support theorem was checked on synthetic fixtures (see execution record); no round cell's law, recovery or scan value was computed before freezing
pre_freeze_exposure.gt_p005_smoke: the GT-P005 pre-freeze smoke run printed flux, partner index and one-way counts for FREE N=4 W4 PATHF weak_suppress, strong_suppress, prohibit, EXCL and NULL (now E3A cells FREE-N4-W4-PF-*, EXCL, NULL); recovery, gate, split and scan channels were never computed

question: How do local prohibitions and conditional rates reshape the space of possible histories: what generates and orients one-way release, how is a released relation recovered, and when is absence persistent?
sampling: 27 cells (8 on published kernels with new channels) and 2 companion scans of 81 grid points each
seeds: sha256('round-e3a:<channel>:<item_id>')[:16] for kernel, affinity, passage and recovery reference samples; trajectories as E0

stop_conditions.amendment: cell or estimand changes stop the round
stop_conditions.round: all items or 7200 s, then stop

work_count.estimate_note: measured before freezing on synthetic cells (execution record)
